title: f1-2 project file safety, version stamp, atomics

commit.merge_subject: merge: f1-2 project file safety, version stamp, atomics

description:
12 focused JVM tests for the project-file safety package
(plan sections 6.4/6.5), covering the plan's own test clauses:

- (a) a version-999 project.json: ProjectFile.open reports TooNew,
  every store's write attempt is suppressed (Grade, Export, Preset,
  Timeline, Audio, Metadata, Gyro, Lut, Source, PreviewQuality,
  RenderBackend, Theme, PreviewStats, LibraryPrefs, GyroFolder,
  ImportFolder, SystemMonitor), and the file survives byte for byte
  with its 999 stamp. The suppression is observable in two ways:
  writeTextIfWritable returns false, and GradeStore's existing
  onTooNew notification still fires.
- (b) ordinary v1 files through a full store sweep stay stamped at 1
  and reopen as Outcome.Open; withSection ignores the caller's
  version both downward (a v2-shaped file stays 2) and upward (a
  caller claiming 7 on a v1 file cannot raise it), and an
  unversioned legacy file st
changed: feat: project file version stamp cannot be dragged down
test: f1-2 gate, stamp policy, backup, atomic parity
